extraction.notes: Whole amending law read (Official Gazette 86/25, two pages). The law only renames ministries and bodies named in the Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners; it adds no new right, obligation or system. Each item records the authority a provision now names. Not itemised: Art. 9 (official of the ministry in a fines provision) and Art. 10 (minister who prescribes the payment order form), which make the same renaming outside the rights and authorities of the law; the later paragraphs of Arts 4 and 5 are noted on the relevant items. Context from MKD-GOV-2015-001 is given in extraction_note, not in summaries. Machine translation by the extracting agent throughout. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2).

items.stated_text: Се прогласува Законот за изменување на Законот за вработување и работа на странци, што Собранието на Република Северна Македонија го донесе на седницата одржана на 22 април 2025 година.
items.translation_en: The Law Amending the Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners, which the Assembly of the Republic of North Macedonia adopted at its session held on 22 April 2025, is hereby promulgated.
items.summary: The President and the Speaker promulgate the amending law on employment and work of foreigners, adopted by the Assembly on 22 April 2025.

items.stated_text: Во Законот за вработување и работа на странци („Службен весник на Република Македонија“ број 217/15 и „Службен весник на Република Северна Македонија“ број 163/21), во член 4 во ставот (1) зборовите: „Министерството за надворешни работи“ се заменуваaт со зборовите: „Министерството за надворешни работи и надворешна трговија“, а зборовите: „Министерството за труд и социјална политика“ се заменуваат со зборовите: „Министерството за економија и труд”.
items.translation_en: In the Law on Employment and Work of Foreigners (Official Gazette of the Republic of Macedonia No. 217/15 and Official Gazette of the Republic of North Macedonia No. 163/21), in Article 4 paragraph (1), the words "the Ministry of Foreign Affairs" are replaced by "the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade", and the words "the Ministry of Labour and Social Policy" are replaced by "the Ministry of Economy and Labour".
items.summary: Article 4(1) now names the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and the Ministry of Economy and Labour.
